validation.method: 4-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on whole training files, seed 42; duplicate waveform groups kept together; fold-fitted preprocessing; selected model refitted on all training files
limitations: Local grouped cross-validation on organiser training recordings; hidden official test performance is unavailable.
The same out-of-fold results select the candidate model, so the displayed winning validation score has model-selection optimism; there is no independent outer test split.
Exact numerical copies and conservative near-identical waveform sketches are grouped; unknown acquisition-run dependence may remain.
Only 14 Side I training files are available. No calibrated confidence, GPS position, remaining life or confirmed maintenance diagnosis is inferred.
Speed is estimated from rising pulse edges with 90 teeth and 0.85 m wheel diameter; one-second boundary truncation introduces counting uncertainty.
